## Facts (3):
- [convention] Notifier email templates (id: 01a1083b-e482-7ec2-8e43-59b93a5cec62; source: shared/human)
  Email templates live in services/notifier/templates/ as `<event>.mjml` and are compiled at build time. Every template needs a plain-text twin `<event>.txt` with the same variables, because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML. Template variables are snake_case.
- [hazard] Email provider: sandbox behaviour and limits (id: 01a1083c-2aa0-7af0-a78b-19fd3a2fcc3c; source: shared/human)
  The notifier sends through the email provider's HTTP API (provider.send). Production credentials exist only in the deployed function's environment. For development there is a separate sandbox account whose key is in the dev secrets store; export it as MAIL_API_KEY. The sandbox has the same API and response shapes, but it is rate-limited to 2 messages per second and capped at 500 messages a day for the whole team, so do not loop over large fixtures. Bounces and complaints are simulated with magic addresses from the provider's docs. Important: the sandbox silently drops (answers 202, never delivers) every message whose recipient is not on the `@sink.acme.test` domain, so a test that asserts delivery must send to an address such as `receipts@sink.acme.test` and read it back from the sink inbox API.
- [context] Who owns the notifier (current) (id: 01a1083c-4b9a-7230-99b6-07de7b923786; source: shared/human)
  As of 2026-09-01 the notifier belongs to the Growth team (Dana Okafor moved to Platform). Template and copy changes are signed off in #growth-eng; any Growth engineer can approve.","hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit"}}

Sends transactional email (receipts, payment reminders) for ledgerline.
It is deployed separately from the billing app, as its own function.

- `notifier/` - the service code
- `migrations/` - the outbox table schema
- `tests/` - unit tests

The Growth team signs off on it. Any Growth engineer can approve, and the request goes through #growth-eng.

This comes from a project memory dated 2026-09-01, when the notifier moved to Growth. Dana Okafor moved to Platform and no longer owns it. I found no CODEOWNERS file, and the notifier README doesn't mention ownership, so I couldn't confirm this from the repo.

An older memory still said Dana's sign-off was required. I challenged it, and the system now marks it as superseded by the newer one.

For the change itself:
- Templates are in `services/notifier/templates/`. The receipt template is a `<event>.mjml` file.
- Each template needs a matching plain-text `<event>.txt` with the same snake_case variables. Update both files.
- To test delivery against the email sandbox, send to an address on `@sink.acme.test`. The sandbox silently drops mail to any other address.
